title: Zhaoqing Long-Distance Power-Line UAV Inspection
description:
Zhaoqing Long-Distance Power-Line UAV Inspection
During an inspection of a 110 kV power line in Zhaoqing, our product demonstrated its high-efficiency and convenient-operation advantages. The line measured 37.9 km in total length, with an average tower height of 35 m, 112 towers, and a maximum elevation difference of 440 m. In this complex environment, the operation completed 10 sorties and successfully inspected the full 37.9 km line. After each sortie, data processing was performed immediately and stitched with the previous sortie data. The final output was complete and standardized, with no duplicate shadows at turning points and no misalignment at stitching points, meeting the high-standard requirements of power-line inspection.
